description: Observed evidence from the AR2 cross-worker smoke pass of the shared archify-safe.mjs wrapper. Encodes only what was actually observed; does not claim three-worker portability.

sharedWrapper.note: One wrapper, shared across all workers; no per-worker Archify integration exists.

pi.detail: Current LPB mutationScope.files is canonical exact-file Set membership only; no directory-prefix/glob support. When mutationScope is active, bash/powershell are categorically blocked as LPB_MUTATION_SCOPE_UNSUPPORTED_TOOL. Read mode exposes no shell/execution tool in the actual capability probe. A transactional CLI writer with an unpredictable same-directory candidate path cannot be safely expressed today without changing the LPB capability model.

codex.detail: Plus Codex rate-limit snapshot: primary 5h window used 0% / remaining 100%; secondary 7d window used 100% / remaining 0%. Turn execution is externally blocked by the secondary window. Reset credits exist but were deliberately not consumed.

overall.note: One safe lane (Claude) produced a real, verified artifact delivery through the shared wrapper. This establishes that the wrapper and runtime pin work for at least one worker; it does not establish three-worker portability. Pi and Codex remain HOLD for reasons external to Archify correctness.
